title: EEP Operator Spending Policy Profile
description: Signed document defining an agent's spending constraints. Consulted before any payment gate interaction to ensure the agent acts within operator-defined financial limits. (§8.4, Whitepaper).

operator_did.description: DID of the human/organizational operator that authored this spending policy.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this policy was issued.

max_per_transaction.description: Maximum allowed spend per single transaction by currency.

max_per_hour.description: Maximum cumulative spend per rolling 1-hour window by currency. Agent pauses if exceeded.

max_per_day.description: Maximum cumulative spend per rolling 24-hour window by currency.

approved_chains.description: Blockchain networks the agent is permitted to transact on. Transactions on non-listed chains are refused.

approved_recipient_categories.description: Gate recipient categories the agent may pay. If set, any recipient not matching is refused without human confirmation.

require_recipient_conformance_level.description: Minimum EEP conformance level the recipient must hold before the agent may pay. Per Whitepaper §10.2: Core, Standard, or Full. The agent refuses payment to recipients below this tier without human confirmation.

require_on_chain_confirmation.description: If true, agent must wait for on-chain finality (using publisher's declared min_confirmations) before marking payment complete.

operator_signature.description: EdDSA signature by operator_did over canonical JSON of this document (excluding operator_signature).
